signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: One account for your wishes, previews and conversations with the agency.
signUp.checkBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.

verifyEmail.doneBody: Your account is ready: you can sign in now.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: A link works once, for a limited time. Enter your e-mail and we'll send you a new one.
verifyEmail.resent: If this e-mail has an account waiting for confirmation, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your e-mail: we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses this address, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for a limited time.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: You'll sign in with it from now on. Every device is signed out.
